item.title: Telluride Ski Patrol Union Rejects Resort’s Final Offer, Holiday Strike Likely

item.title: Russian Skiers Got the OK to Compete in the Olympics; Are Surfers Next?

item.title: Kauai Bans Disposable Bodyboards
item.description: Kaua'i Mayor Derek Kawakami signed into law Bill No. 2976, which prohibits the sale, rental, or distribution of disposable polystyrene foam bodyboards.
